wording.unit: Annual colony census: occupied nest sites (used as a breeding-pair proxy).
wording.unit_detail: Each yearly value is the highest count available for that colony in that year (the record's methods). It is not a count of individual birds, and it is not doubled into individuals. The record says an occupied site in Namibia was a nest with fresh eggs or chicks, and in South Africa also a site defended by an adult or showing recent signs of use.
wording.version_note: Historical census data from the 2021 deposit, ending in 2019. The authors' later analysis file extends to 2023 and differs in some overlapping entries. This chart uses the earlier deposit throughout.
wording.no_total: No total is shown because the colonies counted vary between years; adding the available entries would not compare the same coverage or establish a complete population total.
wording.one_colony: A rise at one colony does not show recovery of the species.
wording.scales: Each chart has its own vertical scale, printed on it. Heights must not be compared between charts.
wording.no_count_general: The record's usage notes say NA marks years in which counts were not conducted, for logistical reasons or because a colony had gone or had not yet been colonised or recolonised. Mother Earth does not give a reason for any single missing entry and says nothing here about whether a colony exists today.
wording.marker: Not a count: model marker, left out
wording.marker_note: The file holds a 0.1 marker at {year}. The record's usage notes say these markers were entered to anchor the authors' model at an end of a series where they knew the population was zero, that they are not count data, and that they should be left out. It is left out here.
wording.archive: A dated record that ends in 2019. Not a live feed and not updated.

later_file.not_counted: One further literal difference, Seal Island Algoa Bay 2003, is only an empty cell in this file against NA in the later one: the same state, not counted.
